FRENCH — MOCK EXAM #16
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: FRENCH
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Oral Expression Clarity Intonation Tone, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Oral Expression Clarity Intonation Tone.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Oral Expression Clarity Intonation Tone.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Oral Expression Clarity Intonation Tone.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Oral Expression Clarity Intonation Tone.

2. When practising Interactive Speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Interactive Speaking.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Interactive Speaking.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Interactive Speaking.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Interactive Speaking.

3. When practising Interactive Listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Interactive Listening.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Interactive Listening.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Interactive Listening.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Interactive Listening.

4. When practising Active Listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   C. Copy random text without understanding Active Listening.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Active Listening.

   A. Use insults to “practise” Listening for Information Attention Note taking Vocabulary.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Listening for Information Attention Note taking Vocabulary.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for Information Attention Note taking Vocabulary.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for Information Attention Note taking Vocabulary.

7. “Bonjour” is used to say: (1 mark)
   A. Good night only
   B. Thank you
   C. Excuse me
   D. Good morning / hello

8. The French word for “book” is: (1 mark)
   A. chaise
   B. livre
   C. porte
   D. fenêtre

9. When practising Oral Expression Clarity Intonation Pacing, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Oral Expression Clarity Intonation Pacing.

10. When practising Active listening 1.4 Listening for information, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Active listening 1.4 Listening for information.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Active listening 1.4 Listening for information.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Active listening 1.4 Listening for information.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Active listening 1.4 Listening for information.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----

12. In three clear sentences, explain Interactive Listening and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
